beats.anchor: Il plonge les deux mains dans la glacière de Mrs. Brooks, la maman de Tyler.
beats.extras: Mrs. Brooks, Tyler's mother: a tall, sun-tanned white woman in her early forties with very pale blond hair in a ponytail, sunglasses pushed up on her head, a sleeveless T-shirt and shorts, laughing. Diego Ramírez (11): a small wiry Salvadoran-American boy with light brown skin, short black hair spiked with gel, in the navy Potomac Valley kit with white number 12, grinning in the background.
beats.outfit: BriBri in the navy Potomac Valley kit with white number 33, black shorts, his red sock on his right foot and yellow sock on his left foot, small soft round afro, the gap in his front teeth showing. Kaydoudou in the navy Potomac Valley kit with white number 8, his fine shaved part on the left, carrying the family's own cooler.
beats.action: BriBri kneels by a huge blue cooler on wheels and plunges both arms into the ice up to the elbows, eyes closed in bliss, cheeks puffed, among floating watermelon slices and orange quarters. Mrs. Brooks laughs and points at his hands. Kaydoudou, behind, shakes his head with a small amused smile.
beats.location: Between two of the twenty fields of a huge summer tournament complex in Maryland: rows of white and blue parents' tents, folding chairs, coolers everywhere, sun-yellowed grass.
beats.light: Early morning August sun, already hot and hazy, sparkling on the ice cubes.
beats.camera: Medium shot at child height, BriBri and the cooler in the foreground, the tents and fields stretching to the horizon behind.
beats.alt: BriBri plonge les deux mains dans la glacière de Mrs. Brooks, ravi d'avoir trouvé l'hiver en plein mois d'août.

beats.anchor: Le ballon rapiécé passe de pied en pied entre les quatre.
beats.extras: Diego Ramírez (11): small wiry Salvadoran-American boy, light brown skin, short black gelled hair, navy Potomac Valley kit with white number 12. Tyler Brooks (12): a tall, broad-shouldered white boy with very pale blond hair, almost white, in the navy kit with white number 9, wearing one red sock on his left foot and one yellow sock on his right foot.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in the navy kit with white number 8, fine shaved part on the left. BriBri in the navy kit with white number 33, red sock on his right foot, yellow sock on his left foot. Mami's ball: an old, slightly misshapen light-brown leather ball with a square of red and yellow wax-print cloth hand-stitched onto it with big stitches.
beats.action: Under the team tent, the four boys stand in a small circle juggling Mami's patched ball in the air. The ball has just gone wrong at the ninth pass and Tyler, leaning forward with a guilty grin, catches it with his hand just before it touches the grass. Diego throws his arms up laughing, BriBri giggles, Kaydoudou smiles and lets it go.
beats.location: A white parents' tent at the edge of a sun-burnt pitch in the tournament complex, coolers and folding chairs around, heat haze over the fields beyond.
beats.light: Strong white early-afternoon sun outside, cooler shade under the tent, warm light on the boys' faces.
beats.camera: Medium shot from just outside the circle, the patched ball and Tyler's hand at the centre, the four faces around it.
beats.alt: Sous la tente, les quatre garçons se passent le ballon de Mami, et Tyler le rattrape avec la main à la neuvième passe.

beats.anchor: Tyler traverse toute la surface et soulève BriBri comme un sac de riz.
beats.extras: Tyler Brooks (12): tall, broad-shouldered, very pale blond hair, navy Potomac Valley kit with white number 9, red sock on his left foot and yellow sock on his right foot, shouting with joy. Diego Ramírez (11): small wiry Salvadoran-American boy, light brown skin, black gelled hair, navy kit with white number 12, leaping toward them. In the background, the Chesapeake United number 5, a huge broad-shouldered defender in a white kit, standing still with his hands on his hips, and their very tall goalkeeper sitting in the grass.
beats.outfit: BriBri in the navy kit with white number 33, soaked with sweat, his red sock on his right foot and yellow sock on his left foot, small soft round afro, the gap in his teeth showing in a huge surprised smile.
beats.action: Tyler has crossed the whole penalty area and lifts BriBri off the ground in a bear hug like a sack of rice, BriBri's legs dangling, his arms flung wide, laughing in disbelief. Diego jumps at them from the side, mid-air, about to land on the pile.
beats.location: The penalty area of a sun-burnt grass pitch in the huge tournament complex in Maryland, the white goal net bulging behind them with the ball still in it, white and blue tents blurred in the heat haze.
beats.light: Harsh bright August afternoon sun, shimmering heat, sparkling drops of sweat.
beats.camera: Low dynamic angle from the grass, Tyler and BriBri towering joyfully in the centre against the bright sky, Diego flying in from the left.
beats.alt: Après le but, Tyler soulève BriBri comme un sac de riz, et Diego leur saute dessus.
